name: RyukSign
subtitle: On-device iOS app signer and installer.
description: RyukSign is an on-device app signer and installer for iOS, derived from Feather. It extends Feather with a Tweak Manager, a built-in File Transfer / Web Manager server, an enhanced download manager, an app update checker, and curated repository support.

apps.name: RyukSign
apps.subtitle: On-device iOS app signer and installer.
apps.localizedDescription: RyukSign is an on-device app signer and installer for iOS, derived from Feather (by claration). Sign and install apps with a .p12 / .mobileprovision pair, manage tweaks (.dylib/.deb/.framework/.bundle/.appex), transfer files over HTTP/WebDAV, and track app updates — entirely on-device.
